episodes.program:
(rule!
 ;; Reconstruct the fixed 20 by 20 emblem from a unique contiguous crop. The
 ;; minority color is the emblem and the majority color is its background.
 ;; Search all eight rotations/reflections, then render the matching full pose.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define mark-enclosed? #f)
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define colors (remove-duplicates (apply append g)))
   (define fg (first (filter (lambda (x) (not (= x bg))) colors)))
   (define runs
    '(((0 1) (15 16))
      ((0 5) (15 16))
      ((0 6) (15 17))
      ((0 1) (5 7) (15 17))
      ((6 8) (14 18))
      ((7 9) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((8 9) (12 14) (17 18))
      ((9 9) (12 12) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((9 12) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((1 9) (11 12) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((1 1) (9 12) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((1 9) (12 12) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((1 1) (3 3) (9 9) (12 14) (17 18))
      ((0 2) (4 9) (14 14) (17 18))
      ((1 1) (3 4) (9 9) (14 18))
      ((0 2) (4 4) (9 9) (13 14) (16 17))
      ((1 1) (3 4) (9 9) (13 13) (17 18))
      ((0 2) (4 4) (9 9) (13 14) (18 19))
      ((1 1) (3 4) (8 8) (10 10) (14 14) (16 18))
      ((0 2) (7 7) (11 11) (14 16))))
   (define base
    (for/list ((r (in-range 20)))
     (for/list ((c (in-range 20)))
      (if (for/or ((span (list-ref runs r)))
            (and (<= (first span) c) (<= c (second span)))) 1 0))))
   (define poses
    (list base (rotate-cw base) (rotate-180 base) (rotate-ccw base)
          (flip-lr base) (flip-ud base) (transpose base)
          (rotate-180 (transpose base))))
   (define crop
    (for/list ((r (in-range h)))
     (for/list ((c (in-range w))) (if (= (at g r c) fg) 1 0))))
   (define (fits? full)
    (for*/or ((r (in-range (+ 1 (- 20 h))))
              (c (in-range (+ 1 (- 20 w)))))
     (equal? crop (subgrid full r c (+ r h -1) (+ c w -1)))))
   (define matched (or (for/first ((full poses) #:when (fits? full)) full) base))
   (define completed
    (for/list ((row matched))
     (for/list ((v row)) (if (= v 1) fg bg))))
   (if mark-enclosed? (fill-all-enclosed completed 2 bg) completed))))
